name: Israel, Gaza & region
value: Gaza strikes kill 6 on 21 Nov; Houthi missiles
summary: Gaza's civil defence says Israeli strikes killed six on 21 Nov; Saudi coalition intercepted 3 Houthi missiles
state: Gaza's civil defence said Israeli strikes killed six people on 21 Nov, including three in a drone strike on a food-aid vehicle in Gaza City; the Israeli military said it targeted militants (Free Malaysia Today, citing AFP; RTE). The health ministry says more than 1,600 Palestinians have been killed since the October 2025 ceasefire. The Saudi-led coalition said it intercepted three Houthi ballistic missiles fired at Riyadh early on 21 Nov, and Israel struck Lebanon's Beqaa on 20 Nov. Hostilities on several fronts keep the Alert.
for_you: Check FCDO travel advice before travelling to Israel, the Palestinian territories, Lebanon, Yemen or Saudi Arabia, and follow it if you are already there.
